'''2011 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Rock and Roll Nevar Forgets'''; username Pucky1. Handwritten. Line 3 Landing Platform (DB) → Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); line 35 '''Black Leader''' → DS-61-2; line 39 '''TTO''' → That Thing's Operational; line 40 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer; line 50 '''Tatooine (ep I)''' → Tatooine. Line 30 Omni Box + It's Worse → Omni Box & It's Worse.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
